content.text: Production-ready 2D pixel art for a fixed-camera three-quarter top-down dark fantasy dungeon game. Match the supplied Overbless pixel-art references: crisp hard pixel clusters, readable silhouette at 128 pixels, dark navy outlines, restrained cyan/purple/orange accents, no antialiasing, no blur, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. Use a perfectly flat pure magenta #ff00ff background around every isolated object. Create the exact same shockwave golem design in one isolated idle key pose facing southeast/down-right, halfway between south and east. Preserve body proportions, rune core, stone cracks, armor colors and lighting. Distinct diagonal silhouette, neutral standing pose, centered, full body, generous empty magenta border.
